source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Once per battle, as the opposing player's [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) starts, this model may call on its psychic familiar: until the phase ends, its Mind Control ability has 6" more range.

A Psychic Familiar token can stay beside the model until this ability is used.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
